content:
mina_cs: FYI: a subset of onboarding jobs using our webhook path got duplicate events during a retry surge. Affects ~9 tenants (mix of trials + smb). Need outbound + dedupe option. @leo_sre can you confirm cause and ETA?

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-077 logged by mina_cs 2 Severity: S3 2 bridge: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-077

leo_sre: Root cause = transient webhook provider retries combined with missing delivery-id dedupe in an edge path. We have a hotfix to enforce idempotency on delivery-id; canary in 10m, full rollout in ~40m.

carla_support: CS playbook: tell customers to temporarily pause webhook retries or add a 1s backoff if their provider supports it. We'll offer a free dedupe sweep and a one-time onboarding credit. I'll prepare the dedupe script for support to run.

frank_ae: Two renewal accounts in the affected list. Please mark them priority and loop me on outreach.

mina_cs: Draft outbound (short + helpful):

"Hi —

Were reaching out because some recent webhook retries caused duplicate onboarding ingestion events for a small number of customers. Our engineers have identified the issue and are rolling a fix; full resolution expected within ~40 minutes.

Immediate actions you can take:
• Pause webhook delivery to your Redwood ingest endpoint or enable a short retry backoff in your webhook provider.
• Reply here if youd like us to run a dedupe sweep for you — well prioritize trial and renewal accounts.

Were hosting office hours for live help and offering a one-time onboarding credit to impacted customers. Office hours: Mon Apr 6, 15:00 UTC — https://cal.me/redwood/webhook-help

Thanks — Redwood Onboarding Team"

opsbot: Office hours scheduled: Mon 2026-04-06 15:00 UTC 2 https://cal.me/redwood/webhook-help

leo_sre: Canary stable; rolling to prod in waves. Will post update when roll completes. Adding integration test for delivery-id dedupe and an alert for duplicate embed rate.

carla_support: Preparing CSV of affected tenants + dedupe checklist. Will attach to outbound and flag accounts for AE outreach list.

mina_cs: Ok sending first to trials, then high-touch after prod confirm. Thanks team.
